plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence published on catalog p. 202 of the official 2023-2024 catalog; AA-T in English requires 19 major units (ENGL 1B and ENGL 5 core; 6 units List A; 3 units List B; 3 units List C). The sequence satisfies List A with ENGL 30A and ENGL 30B, List B with ENGL 10A or ENGL 47, and List C with ENGL 31. REQUIREMENT 'Major, List A/B/C' mapped to major; 'US/CA Politics'/'US History' mapped to core. Footnote 1: HUMAN 2 must be taken at College of Alameda to count for the specific CSU GE area. All ENGL courses above ENGL 1A list 'ENGL 001A or ENGL 001AS' as prerequisite (ENGL 1B lists ENGL 1A); coded as ENGL 1A because the validator only matches top-level course codes and ENGL 1AS appears solely inside the Fall Y1 ENGL choice's options — the in-plan Fall Y1 ENGL 1A/1AS choice satisfies the prerequisite. Catalog quirks: 'ENGL 32A Contemporary Woman Writers' (singular 'Woman'; requirements list 'Contemporary Women Writers') — kept verbatim. 'AFRAM 31 African-American History: 1865-1945' (in other sequences AFRAM 30 carries the '1865-1945' title) — kept verbatim. Choice credits use the first-listed option's units (SPAN 1A 5 units; ENGL 79 3 units); the '5 or 3' and '3 or 2' alternatives are documented in the choice_notes. Fall Y2 prints '16-18', Spring Y2 prints '15-16'. Computed total 63. Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes, 416 pages; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750): recommended course sequence verified identical to the 2023-2024 transcription. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
